notes: WHAT CHANGED. js/live-content.js only (plus tests and one doc section). A3: Go back is a transition. Both answers are disabled while the browser leaves; a restored document (pageshow after pagehide, or persisted), popstate/hashchange, or 1.5 s still on the page gives them back with focus on Go back; after a Go back that went nowhere the next one exits by the referrer or about:blank; agreement recorded elsewhere is read on pageshow, visibilitychange, window focus and storage and takes the wall down in place, once (release() has one caller, guarded by readAck()). A4: a page opened with #mcc_handoff= is concealed as the head script runs (same data-privacy-gate=pending attribute js/main.js already honours), shows one status line and no answers, and ends in the question (refused, 10 s without word, or no reload 4 s after sign-in) or in entry on the member's own record; the World takes the session in place, so its record is read on the next tick instead of 4 s later. ONE EXISTING TEST WAS CHANGED, DELIBERATELY. 'the notice: a cross-host sign-in handoff is finished before the notice looks' asserted the A4 defect three times (shown() === false, 'nothing while the handoff runs'). Those three assertions now assert asked() === false (what was meant) and concealed() === true (what was missing); every other line of that test is kept and extended. No other existing assertion was changed, skipped or removed. The harness gained persistent listeners, document events and a loading state; the 20 pre-existing tests in that file pass unchanged on it. THE FAILING GITHUB CHECK. It is `smoke` (Site smoke gate, run 42095784300, job 127485565375). Seven assertions failed, all '<page> loads: TimeoutError: page.goto: Timeout 30000ms exceeded' from scripts/smoke.mjs line 842 (waitUntil networkidle): reset-password.html, hire.html, sites.html, demo.html?s=shiloh, onboard.html?plan=web&mode=paid at 390 px; gallery.html and demo.html?s=shiloh at 1280 px. Every other assertion on those pages passed, and so did all 21 [the notice] assertions. It is NOT A3 or A4: the walk seeds agreement, so the gate script returns at its first read before any wall, Go back or handoff code; none of the seven URLs carries a handoff. The gate itself is clean here on base and on head (450/450 each). The same error was reproduced with a probe that walks 13 of the pages the same way (evidence/smoke-idle-probe.mjs): 3 stalls in 507 loads when seeded as this PR seeds the walk (mcc_privacy_ack, analytics on), 0 in 195 loads when seeded as main does (mcc_privacy_seen, analytics off); one stall ran the full 30 s with no page request left open and 16 s of network silence, and in the base-tree stall the request still open was a POST to the analytics collector (supabase functions/v1/collect), which only exists when analytics is on. PR #760 changed that seed in scripts/smoke.mjs, so the likely cause is first-party analytics running, for the first time, inside a sealed walk that waits for network idle. 3 in 507 against 0 in 195 does not prove it. Not fixed here because it is outside A3/A4; a candidate remedy for the owner is to keep the walk agreed but answer or drop the two collector endpoints before the page issues them, or to wait for load instead of networkidle. THE PACKET'S OWN REPRO. audit-details/auth-owner-repros.mjs still prints 'CONFIRMED state-machine defect' for A3 on this head if run unmodified: its fixture puts persisted in event.detail (a browser puts it on the event), sends no pagehide and never advances its clock, so the gate sees an ordinary first pageshow 0 ms after Go back. With the flag on the event, or with 1.5 s allowed to pass, its defect assertion fails on this head (reloads 1, expected 0). Its A4 assertion (wall() === false during the handoff) fails on this head as is. Logs: evidence/audit-packet-repro-*.log. DESIGN CHOICES A REVIEWER MAY WANT TO OVERRULE. (1) While held there are no buttons at all, only the status line, so nothing can be pressed that does nothing and an answer cannot appear under a finger; the wait is bounded by 10 s (4 s more after a sign-in on a page that reloads). (2) Agreement found elsewhere takes the wall down in place rather than reloading; analytics for that page view stay off, as after agreeing on the policy page. (3) Agree is disabled together with Go back for the at most 1.5 s the browser is given to leave. (4) After a Go back that did not leave, the next one uses location.replace (referrer, else about:blank) instead of history.back() again, which could walk back two pages if the first was only slow. OBSERVED, NOT CHANGED. js/live-content.js is not in the paths filter of .github/workflows/human-uprise-editorial.yml, so the music-world suite runs on this PR only because the PR also touches js/analytics.js and the suite itself. The gate holds for a handoff when it finds no session in mccdb_session or mcc_sess_keep, while js/tabbar.js hands off when mccdb_session alone is empty; where they disagree the gate waits its 10 s and then asks, as before but now concealed. A malformed percent-encoded handoff token throws inside js/tabbar.js (audit finding on the handoff lane); the gate then also waits 10 s and asks. The Privacy Policy page's own status line is not refreshed when that page is restored from the back/forward cache. scripts/e2e/music-world-continuity.e2e.mjs is also touched by PR #785, so expect a textual merge there. EVIDENCE is beside this file in evidence/: fail-before and pass-after logs, the CI job log, the smoke probe and its five runs, the mutation matrix, and screenshots of the held dialog (320, 390, 768, 1280) and of the restored wall.
